A '''Zaxxovian Special''' was a type of [[starfighter]]<ref name="Vehicles" /> that originated from the [[Zaxxovia system]].<ref name="Fry">{{EmailCite|email=File:AtlasEmail-2025-07-09.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-07-09}}</ref> The [[pilot]] [[Jarek Yeager]] had a [[Racing starfighter|racer]] that was a [[Jarek Yeager's racer|modified Zaxxovian Special]].<ref name="Vehicles" />
